paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 55b: “It was taught: Eliezer of Biriya says.”[^1]

notes.text: The saved whole William Davidson Hebrew Eruvin55b paragraph has תניא נמי הכי, אליעזר איש ביריא אומר. Hyman's shorter It was taught formula and untitled Eliezer of Biriya are retained; no Rav or Rabbi is supplied.
